harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as router between node2 and node3, addressed the two transit links (eth1/192.168.1.1 to node2, eth2/192.168.2.1 to node3), enabled L3 forwarding, and installed an nftables forward-chain ACL that allows TCP 8080 and rejects (TCP reset) TCP 23 between the two links while leaving all other forwarded traffic (default-accept) untouched. Configuration was persisted (sysctl.d, ifupdown fragments on node2/node3, a systemd oneshot + /etc/antrieb-acl.nft on node1) and verified to survive a one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes with changed boot IDs and full functional recovery.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1 eth1<->node2 ens7 and node1 eth2<->node3 ens7 point-to-point links, node1 eth0 on shared management network
Cleaned docker0 stale class-E address and stopped interfaces-config.service reconciler on node1 per SONiC reference
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1
Added routes on node2/node3 via node1 for the opposite transit subnet
Verified base L3 connectivity (ping) between node2 and node3 through node1
Created nftables table inet acl with a forward-hook chain: accept tcp dport 8080 between eth1/eth2, reject (tcp reset) tcp dport 23 between eth1/eth2, default policy accept for everything else
Functionally verified: HTTP on 8080 succeeds, telnet-style connection on 23 is refused (TCP RST), ICMP passes untouched

Persisted configuration: /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf, /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg on node2/node3, /etc/antrieb-acl.nft + antrieb-lan.service (enabled) on node1, idempotent nft file using declare+delete+define pattern
Captured baseline boot_id and functional health on all three nodes
Restarted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of addressing/routes/connectivity
Restarted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id and full recovery
Restarted node1 last (router), polled until reachable (SONiC multi-container boot), confirmed new boot_id and full recovery of eth1/eth2 addressing, sysctls, and nft ACL table
Re-ran end-to-end functional test (8080 allow, 23 refuse, ping pass) after all three restarts to confirm post-recovery correctness
Cleaned up temporary test HTTP servers on node3

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Assigned transit-link addressing/routes, started an HTTP listener on node3:8080, and confirmed node2 receives HTTP 200 both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 refuses TCP port 23 between node2 and node3
evidence.summary: nft forward-chain rule rejects tcp dport 23 with tcp reset between eth1/eth2; curl from node2 to node3:23 gets 'Connection refused' both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: rest of forwarded traffic between node2 and node3 is left untouched
evidence.summary: Forward chain policy is accept and only matches dport 8080/23; ICMP ping between node2 and node3 through node1 succeeds both pre- and post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f6f9440e and functional health pre-restart, issued sudo reboot (connection dropped confirming ack), polled until boot_id changed to f56c387b, then verified ens7 addressing/routes and 8080/23/ping behavior recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2ba78175 and functional health pre-restart, issued sudo reboot (connection dropped confirming ack), polled until boot_id changed to 655a975c, then verified ens7 addressing/routes recovered and re-established test listeners successfully

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 39fdb9ab and functional health pre-restart, issued reboot (log confirmed 'requested COLD shutdown', subsequent poll got connection reset mid-shutdown confirming ack), polled through SONiC's multi-container boot until reachable again with new boot_id 27e2c370, then verified eth1/eth2 addressing, sysctl forwarding, and the persisted nft ACL table all recovered automatically via the enabled antrieb-lan.service

evidence.requirement: configuration persists across reboot (not just runtime state)
evidence.summary: Installed /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf, /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg (node2/node3), and an enabled antrieb-lan.service + idempotent /etc/antrieb-acl.nft (node1); confirmed idempotent re-application produces no rule duplication and state matches original config after actual reboot
